title: Collections Casebook: Past-Due Carry and Catch-Up Amounts in Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Unit Notices
content:
**Rule.** The past-due balance the unit notice amount carries on a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization is:

- **nothing**, where the catch-up amount on the notice history for the oldest unpaid due date is at least the past-due balance left after the in-flight draft;
- **that past-due balance less the catch-up amount**, where a smaller catch-up amount is on record;
- **otherwise, the whole past-due balance left after the in-flight draft.**

**Records read.** The catch-up amount on record is the total of the amounts stated on the varying-amount notices on the authorization's notice history whose due date is the agreement's oldest unpaid due date (the date the agreement has been delinquent since). The past-due balance left after the in-flight draft is the balance due on the handling date less the amount the in-flight draft counts at, never below nothing.

### Cases (hypothetical figures; past-due balance left after the in-flight draft $200.00 in each)

| Case | Varying-amount notices for the oldest unpaid due date | Catch-up amount on record | Past-due balance carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | One notice stating $200.00 | $200.00 | Nothing — the catch-up equals the balance |
| 2 | One notice stating $260.00 | $260.00 | Nothing — the catch-up is above the balance |
| 3 | One notice stating $120.00 | $120.00 | $80.00 |
| 4 | Two notices stating $55.00 and $65.00 | $120.00 | $80.00 |
| 5 | None for that due date (a notice exists only for a later due date) | none | $200.00 |

Case 5 turns on the due date the notice names: only notices whose due date is the agreement's oldest unpaid due date are read. In case 1 the boundary is met exactly, and nothing is carried.
